name: codedag
description: Teaches your agent the essentials of using CodeDAG, such as writing and submitting workflows, supervising their runs, and reviewing the results.

interface.shortDescription: Teaches your agent the essentials of using CodeDAG, such as writing and submitting workflows, supervising their runs, and reviewing the results.
interface.longDescription: Use CodeDAG when coding work is better split across agents: it runs dependent tasks such as planning, implementation, testing, and code review as one workflow, unattended or in parallel across Git worktrees, mixing Claude Code and Codex and pausing for review where you choose. This skill lets your agent write, submit, supervise, and review those workflows.
defaultPrompt: Use CodeDAG to validate and submit the workflow in this repository.
Use CodeDAG to inspect the workflow status and review the blocked task.
